newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN SHARES DRIFT LOWER, HOIUPANK BUCKS TREND.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN SHARES DRIFT LOWER, HOIUPANK BUCKS TREND.

text.p: Estonian shares eased slightly on Wednesday as another bout of profit-taking and market jitters hit the bourse and dealers did not expect gains until next week.
Dealers said the market was nervous and the direction unclear for much of the session as profit-taking brought prices in key banking shares down.
Investors are expected to reap more profits this week but the market, which recently rampaged to new highs, is expected to rebound next week, dealers said.
The index inched down by 0.34 percent to 398.33 and overall market turnover was 114.3 million kroons compared to 134.3 million kroons on Tuesday.

Market leader Hansapank shed 2.5 kroons to close at 216.5 kroons in trade of 18.6 million kroons. Uhispank was the most active share as it eased to 89.90 kroons from 92.25 kroons in trade of 28.1 million kroons.
Hoiupank bucked the general trend in the banking sector as it gained five kroons to close at 260 kroons on turnover of 16.8 million kroons.
"Hoiupank was boosted by the release of the results from its insurance arm and it seems stable at this level," said one dealer.
On the free market, total trade was 21.6 million kroons. Privatisation securities were the most active stocks with 14.5 million kroons traded to close up at 0.42 kroons versus 0.41 kroons.
